concepts.title: Position Vector and Magnitude
concepts.definition: A directed segment originating from the coordinate origin to a given point in space defines its position vector, whose length represents the Euclidean distance from the origin.
concepts.key_idea: Distance of a point from origin gives the norm of its position vector.
question_patterns: find the magnitude of position vector
calculate length of vector given coordinates
determine magnitude of xi + yj + zk
what is the magnitude of vector
Explain the method of Position Vector and Magnitude.

solution_steps.explain: sum the squares of the rectangular components
take the square root of the sum of squares

solution_steps.action: State the magnitude as the length of the position vector
solution_steps.explain: The computed magnitude represents the Euclidean distance from the origin to the point (x, y, z).

concepts.title: Direction Cosines and Direction Ratios
concepts.definition: The cosines of angles made by a vector with positive coordinate axes are its direction cosines, which are proportional to the scalar components of the vector.
concepts.formula: l = x / r, m = y / r, n = z / r where r = sqrt(x**2 + y**2 + z**2)
concepts.key_idea: Normalizing rectangular components yields direction cosines whose sum of squares equals one.
question_patterns: find direction cosines of vector
calculate direction cosines from vector components
determine direction ratios and cosines
what are the direction cosines of xi + yj + zk
Explain the method of Direction Cosines and Direction Ratios.

solution_steps.explain: compute magnitude r of the vector
divide x component by total length
divide y component by total length
divide z component by total length

concepts.title: Unit Vector in Direction of a Vector
concepts.definition: A vector having magnitude of unity along the direction of a non-zero vector, obtained by dividing the vector by its own magnitude.
concepts.key_idea: Scaling a vector by the reciprocal of its norm creates a unit vector.
question_patterns: find unit vector in direction of vector
calculate unit vector along given vector
determine unit vector for xi + yj + zk
what is the unit vector of given vector
Explain the method of Unit Vector in Direction of a Vector.

concepts.title: Vector Joining Two Points
concepts.definition: The directed line segment from an initial point to a terminal point, obtained by subtracting the position vector of the initial point from that of the terminal point.
concepts.key_idea: Difference of terminal and initial coordinates yields components of the displacement vector.
question_patterns: find vector joining two points
calculate vector directed from initial to terminal point
determine vector between point A and point B
what is the displacement vector joining P and Q
Explain the method of Vector Joining Two Points.

solution_steps.explain: subtract initial x from terminal x
subtract initial y from terminal y
subtract initial z from terminal z

concepts.title: Section Formula for Vectors
concepts.definition: Determines the position vector of a point dividing the line segment joining two given points in a specified ratio internally or externally.
concepts.key_idea: Weighted average of position vectors gives internal division point.
question_patterns: find position vector dividing line in given ratio
calculate internal division point vector
determine position vector of point R dividing PQ in ratio m:n
what is the position vector of midpoint
Explain the method of Section Formula for Vectors.

concepts.title: Scalar (Dot) Product of Two Vectors
concepts.definition: An algebraic operation taking two vectors and returning a single scalar equal to the product of their magnitudes and the cosine of the angle between them.
concepts.key_idea: Sum of products of corresponding rectangular components gives the dot product.
question_patterns: find scalar product of two vectors
calculate dot product of vectors
determine dot product of a and b
what is the scalar product of two given vectors
Explain the method of Scalar (Dot) Product of Two Vectors.

solution_steps.explain: product of x components of both vectors
product of y components of both vectors
product of z components of both vectors

concepts.title: Angle Between Two Vectors
concepts.definition: The inclination between two non-zero vectors, whose cosine is the ratio of their scalar product to the product of their individual magnitudes.
concepts.key_idea: Dot product normalized by product of magnitudes gives the cosine of inclination.
question_patterns: find angle between two vectors
calculate cosine of angle between vectors
determine angle between vector a and vector b
what is the angle between given vectors
Explain the method of Angle Between Two Vectors.

solution_steps.explain: divide dot product by product of magnitudes

concepts.title: Projection of a Vector on Another Vector
concepts.definition: The scalar length of the orthogonal projection of one vector along the directional line of another vector.
concepts.key_idea: Dot product of first vector with unit vector of second gives scalar projection.
question_patterns: find projection of vector a on vector b
calculate scalar projection of a on b
determine projection of one vector onto another
what is projection of vector on given vector
Explain the method of Projection of a Vector on Another Vector.

solution_steps.explain: calculate scalar product of vectors a and b
divide dot product by target magnitude

concepts.title: Vector (Cross) Product of Two Vectors
concepts.definition: A binary vector operation resulting in a vector perpendicular to both input vectors, with magnitude equal to the product of magnitudes and sine of angle between them.
concepts.key_idea: Determinant expansion of rectangular components yields perpendicular resultant vector.
question_patterns: find vector product of two vectors
calculate cross product of vectors
determine cross product of a and b
what is vector product of two given vectors
Explain the method of Vector (Cross) Product of Two Vectors.

solution_steps.action: compute x component of cross product
compute y component of cross product
compute z component of cross product

solution_steps.explain: calculate length of cross product vector

concepts.title: Area of Triangle and Parallelogram using Cross Product
concepts.definition: Geometric area formed by adjacent side vectors, equal to magnitude of cross product for parallelogram and half magnitude for triangle.
concepts.formula: area_parallelogram = |a x b|, area_triangle = (1/2) * |a x b|
concepts.key_idea: Norm of vector product measures parallelogram region spanned by two vectors.
question_patterns: find area of parallelogram with given adjacent side vectors
calculate area of triangle formed by two vectors
determine area of triangle with given vertices
what is the area of parallelogram spanned by vectors
Explain the method of Area of Triangle and Parallelogram using Cross Product.

solution_steps.action: compute x component of cross product
compute y component of cross product
compute z component of cross product

solution_steps.explain: find length of vector cross product
half of cross product magnitude gives triangle area
